1: -- WarLegend RaidTool - Cooldown text (the idea of OmniCC)
   2: -- The time left written on the spell buttons and icons. Not an engine of our own: the client's own countdown
   3: -- numbers (CVar countdownForCooldowns), drawn by the game, so they also work on the cooldowns it keeps secret
   4: -- in PvP. The value the player had is put back when the option is switched off.
   5: local W = WLRT
   6: W.AddFR({
   7:     ["Cooldown text"] = "Texte de recharge",
   8:     ["Show the time left on spell buttons and icons"] = "Afficher le temps restant sur les boutons de sorts et les icônes",
   9:     ["Uses the game's own countdown numbers (option \"countdownForCooldowns\"). If your action bar addon already writes them, leave this off."] =
  10:         "Utilise les chiffres de recharge du jeu (option « countdownForCooldowns »). Si ton addon de barres d'action les affiche déjà, laisse ceci désactivé.",
  11:     ["This client has no countdown option."] = "Ce client n'a pas l'option de compte à rebours.",
  12: })
  13: local L = W.L
  14: local db
  15: local CVAR = "countdownForCooldowns"
  16: 
  17: local function GetCV(name)
  18:     if C_CVar and C_CVar.GetCVar then return C_CVar.GetCVar(name) end
  19:     return GetCVar and GetCVar(name)
  20: end
  21: local function SetCV(name, value)
  22:     if C_CVar and C_CVar.SetCVar then return pcall(C_CVar.SetCVar, name, value) end
  23:     if SetCVar then return pcall(SetCVar, name, value) end
  24: end
  25: 
  26: W.OnReady(function()
  27:     db = W.DB("cooldownText", { enabled = false, previous = "" })
  28: end)
  29: 
  30: local function Apply()
  31:     if not db then return end
  32:     local cur = GetCV(CVAR)
  33:     if cur == nil then return end
  34:     if db.enabled then
  35:         if cur ~= "1" then
  36:             if db.previous == "" then db.previous = cur end
  37:             SetCV(CVAR, "1")
  38:         end
  39:     elseif db.previous ~= "" then
  40:         SetCV(CVAR, db.previous)
  41:         db.previous = ""
  42:     end
  43: end
  44: W.On("PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD", function(isLogin, isReload) if isLogin or isReload then Apply() end end)
  45: 
  46: W.RegisterModule("CooldownText", L("Cooldown text"), function(p)
  47:     W.Title(p, L("Cooldown text"))
  48:     if GetCV(CVAR) == nil then
  49:         W.Label(p, L("This client has no countdown option."), "GameFontDisable"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", 16, -44)
  50:         return
  51:     end
  52:     W.Check(p, L("Show the time left on spell buttons and icons"), function() return db.enabled end,
  53:         function(v) db.enabled = v; Apply() end):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", 12, -40)
  54:     local info = W.Label(p, L("Uses the game's own countdown numbers (option \"countdownForCooldowns\"). If your action bar addon already writes them, leave this off."),
  55:         "GameFontHighlightSmall")
  56:     info:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", 16, -76)
  57:     info:SetWidth(700)
  58:     info:SetJustifyH("LEFT")
  59:     info:SetTextColor(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
  60: end)
